notes:
Graphics fix — overlays and pack previews render again.

• Fixed the bug that stopped every graphic from drawing: the pack renderer failed to start up, so the editor preview stayed blank and nothing reached your stream
• Applying a graphic from the live control panel works again
• A graphic added on the Graphics screen now reaches a studio that is already open
• A graphic that can't be drawn tells you why instead of leaving an empty box
• New: Profile › Diagnostics lists any error the app recovered from, with one-tap Copy so you can send it to support
